newsitem.title: USA: Tetra Tech in $50 mln Energy Dept contract.
newsitem.headline: Tetra Tech in $50 mln Energy Dept contract.

text.p: Tetra Tech Inc. said Wednesday it signed a contract with the Department of Energy with a potential value of $50 million over five years.

Tetra Tech will provide nationwide environmental support services which include environmental impact statements and other documents to assess the consequences of continued operation, modification and closure of nuclear and non-nuclear facilities.
The program will also include support for energy programs, construction of new facilities and privatization of DOE facilities.
